title: KCSAN: data-race in __ep_remove / __fput (5)
two_threads_summary: KCSAN-reported two-context race. KCSAN: data-race in __ep_remove / __fput (5)
audit_notes: Subject: 'epoll: annotate racy check'. Pre-classifier PROBABLY_GOOD (real synchronization primitives on + lines).
fix_commit_message:
6474353a5e3d0b2cf610153cea0c61f576a36d0a
epoll: annotate racy check

Epoll relies on a racy fastpath check during __fput() in
eventpoll_release() to avoid the hit of pointlessly acquiring a
semaphore. Annotate that race by using WRITE_ONCE() and READ_ONCE().
